Tech Meets Problems is a builder-first community in Siegen, Germany.

It connects technical talent with real challenges from companies and the region. Community members work in small teams on problem framing, workflows, mockups, concepts and first prototypes.

It is for developers, technical students, HCI/UX people, data and AI profiles, and other practical problem solvers.

Pizza & Prototypes was the first pilot format. Future sessions are listed only when confirmed.

Companies and regional organizations can propose a real problem, support a session, or start a conversation at:
https://techmeetsproblems.com/companies/

Main URL: https://techmeetsproblems.com/

Contact: info@techmeetsproblems.com or via the website forms.
